exams.name: OSHA 10-Hour Construction
exams.blurb: Ten-hour entry-level outreach course covering the Focus Four hazards, required on many construction sites and by several states.

exams.name: OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training
exams.blurb: Ten-hour Outreach Training Program course on 29 CFR 1910 hazards, worker rights and abatement, ending in a DOL completion card.

exams.name: OSHA 10-Hour Maritime Industry Outreach Training
exams.blurb: Ten-hour Outreach course for shipyard, marine terminal and longshoring workers covering hazards under 29 CFR Parts 1915, 1917 and 1918.

exams.name: OSHA 2015 Hazardous Materials
exams.blurb: Course covering OSHA hazardous materials standards including flammable liquids, spray finishing, dip tanks and welding hazards.

exams.name: OSHA 2045 Machinery and Machine Guarding Standards
exams.blurb: Course on Subpart O machine guarding requirements, point-of-operation safeguards and lockout of hazardous energy during servicing.

exams.name: OSHA 2055 Cranes in Construction
exams.blurb: Course on 29 CFR 1926 Subpart CC crane requirements including assembly, operator qualification, signalling and power-line safety.

exams.name: OSHA 2225 Respiratory Protection
exams.blurb: Course on building a written respiratory protection programme, respirator selection, fit testing and medical evaluation.

exams.name: OSHA 2255 Principles of Ergonomics
exams.blurb: Course on recognising musculoskeletal risk factors and applying engineering and administrative controls to reduce workplace strain.

exams.name: OSHA 2264 Permit-Required Confined Space Entry
exams.blurb: Course covering permit space programmes, atmospheric testing instruments, ventilation and non-entry rescue techniques.

exams.name: OSHA 30-Hour Construction
exams.blurb: Supervisor-level outreach training covering hazard recognition, OSHA standards and site safety management responsibilities.

exams.name: OSHA 30-Hour General Industry Outreach Training
exams.blurb: Thirty-hour Outreach course for supervisors and safety staff covering general industry standards, programme management and recordkeeping.

exams.name: OSHA 30-Hour Maritime Industry Outreach Training
exams.blurb: Thirty-hour Outreach course for maritime supervisors covering shipyard employment, marine terminals and longshoring safety standards.

exams.name: OSHA 3015 Excavation, Trenching and Soil Mechanics
exams.blurb: Course on soil classification, sloping, shoring and shielding systems used to protect workers in excavations and trenches.

exams.name: OSHA 3085 Principles of Scaffolding
exams.blurb: Course covering scaffold types, load capacities, erection and dismantling procedures and Subpart L inspection requirements.

exams.name: OSHA 3095 Electrical Standards
exams.blurb: Course on OSHA electrical standards, hazard analysis, grounding, wiring methods and safety-related work practices.

exams.name: OSHA 3115 Fall Protection
exams.blurb: Course on fall hazard recognition, guardrail and net systems, personal fall arrest components and rescue planning.

exams.name: OSHA 500 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Construction Industry
exams.blurb: Authorisation course allowing safety professionals to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour construction Outreach classes and issue DOL cards.

exams.name: OSHA 501 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for General Industry
exams.blurb: Authorisation course allowing safety professionals to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour general industry Outreach classes and issue DOL cards.

exams.name: OSHA 502 Update for Construction Industry Outreach Trainers
exams.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised construction Outreach trainers to maintain their trainer status.

exams.name: OSHA 503 Update for General Industry Outreach Trainers
exams.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised general industry Outreach trainers to maintain their trainer status.

exams.name: OSHA 510 Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Construction Industry
exams.blurb: Prerequisite course covering 29 CFR 1926 construction standards for candidates preparing to take the OSHA 500 trainer course.

exams.name: OSHA 511 Occupational Safety and Health Standards for General Industry
exams.blurb: Prerequisite course covering 29 CFR 1910 general industry standards for candidates preparing to take the OSHA 501 trainer course.

exams.name: OSHA 521 Guide to Industrial Hygiene
exams.blurb: Course on industrial hygiene principles, sampling instrumentation, noise, ventilation and chemical exposure evaluation.

exams.name: OSHA 5400 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Maritime Industry
exams.blurb: Authorisation course allowing instructors to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour maritime Outreach classes and issue DOL completion cards.

exams.name: OSHA 5402 Update for Maritime Industry Outreach Trainers
exams.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised maritime Outreach trainers to retain trainer authorisation.

exams.name: OSHA 5410 Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Maritime Industry
exams.blurb: Prerequisite course covering shipyard, marine terminal and longshoring standards for candidates entering the OSHA 5400 trainer course.

exams.name: OSHA 5600 Disaster Site Worker Trainer Course
exams.blurb: Authorisation course for instructors delivering the Disaster Site Worker Outreach programme to skilled support personnel.

exams.name: OSHA 5602 Update for Disaster Site Worker Trainers
exams.blurb: Update course required at four-year intervals for authorised Disaster Site Worker Outreach trainers.

exams.name: OSHA 5810 Hazard Recognition and Standards for On-Shore Oil and Gas Exploration and Production
exams.blurb: Course covering drilling, well servicing and production hazards along with the OSHA standards that apply to upstream oil and gas sites.

exams.name: OSHA 6005 Collateral Duty Course for Other Federal Agencies
exams.blurb: Course preparing federal collateral-duty safety personnel to conduct workplace inspections under Executive Order 12196.

exams.name: OSHA 7000 Training Guidelines for Safe Patient Handling
exams.blurb: Short course on ergonomic risks in patient handling and the lift equipment and programmes that reduce caregiver injuries.

exams.name: OSHA 7115 Lockout/Tagout
exams.blurb: Short course on developing energy control procedures, applying lockout devices and auditing hazardous energy control programmes.

exams.name: OSHA 7200 Bloodborne Pathogens Exposure Control for Healthcare Facilities
exams.blurb: Short course on writing exposure control plans and selecting engineering controls for healthcare bloodborne pathogen hazards.

exams.name: OSHA 7215 Silica in Construction, Maritime and General Industries
exams.blurb: Short course on the respirable crystalline silica standards, exposure assessment and control methods across three industry sectors.

exams.name: OSHA 7300 Understanding OSHA's Permit-Required Confined Space Standard
exams.blurb: Short course explaining permit space identification, entry permits, attendant duties and rescue requirements under 1910.146.

exams.name: OSHA 7405 Fall Hazard Awareness for the Construction Industry
exams.blurb: Short course on common construction fall hazards and the guardrail, net and personal arrest solutions that prevent them.

exams.name: OSHA 7500 Introduction to Safety and Health Management
exams.blurb: Short course introducing management leadership, worker participation, hazard identification and programme evaluation elements.

exams.name: OSHA 7505 Introduction to Incident (Accident) Investigation
exams.blurb: Short course on evidence collection, witness interviewing and root cause analysis techniques for workplace incident investigations.

exams.name: OSHA 7510 Introduction to OSHA for Small Business
exams.blurb: Short course orienting small employers to OSHA standards, inspection procedures, consultation services and compliance resources.

exams.name: OSHA 7600 Disaster Site Worker Course
exams.blurb: Fifteen-hour Outreach course preparing skilled support personnel for the hazards and respiratory protection needs of disaster response sites.

exams.name: OSHA 7605 Disaster Site Worker Refresher Course
exams.blurb: Shorter refresher of the Disaster Site Worker Outreach programme for personnel maintaining disaster response qualifications.

exams.name: OSHA 7845 Recordkeeping Rule Seminar
exams.blurb: Seminar on 29 CFR 1904 injury and illness recordkeeping, the OSHA 300 log, reporting triggers and electronic submission rules.

exams.name: Associate Ergonomics Professional
exams.body: Board of Certification in Professional Ergonomics (BCPE)
exams.blurb: Interim BCPE credential for ergonomics graduates who have passed the written examination but not yet completed practice requirements.

exams.name: Associate Safety and Health Manager
exams.body: Institute for Safety and Health Management (ISHM)
exams.blurb: Entry-level ISHM credential for early-career practitioners moving toward full safety and health management certification.

exams.name: Associate Safety Professional
exams.blurb: Five-hour examination on safety fundamentals that also satisfies the credential prerequisite for the Certified Safety Professional.

exams.name: Certified Dangerous Goods Professional
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals managing multimodal dangerous goods shipping compliance under DOT, IATA, IMDG and TDG rules.

exams.name: Certified Environmental, Safety and Health Trainer
exams.blurb: BCSP certification for professionals who design and deliver environmental, safety and health training programmes to workers.

exams.name: Certified Ergonomics Associate
exams.body: Board of Certification in Professional Ergonomics (BCPE)
exams.blurb: Technician-level ergonomics certification for practitioners applying established ergonomic methods and workplace assessment tools.

exams.name: Certified Fire and Explosion Investigator
exams.blurb: Certification examining origin and cause methodology from NFPA 921 for investigators of fire and explosion incidents.

exams.name: Certified Hazardous Materials Manager
exams.blurb: Senior certification covering hazardous waste regulation, risk assessment, emergency planning and environmental management systems.

exams.name: Certified Hazardous Materials Practitioner
exams.blurb: Practitioner-level hazardous materials certification for staff implementing waste handling, storage and compliance procedures.

exams.name: Certified Human Factors Professional
exams.body: Board of Certification in Professional Ergonomics (BCPE)
exams.blurb: BCPE certification for practitioners applying human factors research to system, interface and equipment design.

exams.name: Certified Industrial Hygienist
exams.blurb: Leading industrial hygiene certification examining exposure assessment, toxicology, ventilation, noise and control strategies.

exams.name: Certified Instructional Trainer
exams.blurb: BCSP credential for trainers demonstrating instructional design and delivery skills across safety and technical subject matter.

exams.name: Certified Occupational Safety Manager
exams.blurb: Management-level safety certification covering programme development, leadership, regulatory compliance and performance measurement.

exams.name: Certified Occupational Safety Specialist
exams.blurb: Multi-day course and examination on OSHA general industry and construction standards for site-level safety specialists.

exams.name: Certified Professional Ergonomist
exams.body: Board of Certification in Professional Ergonomics (BCPE)
exams.blurb: Senior BCPE certification for ergonomists with graduate education and documented practice in workplace and product design.

exams.name: Certified Safety and Health Manager
exams.body: Institute for Safety and Health Management (ISHM)
exams.blurb: Certification for safety managers covering programme leadership, risk assessment, regulatory compliance and business integration.

exams.name: Certified Safety and Health Official
exams.blurb: Certificate awarded by OTI Education Centers after a defined series of OSHA numbered courses in construction or general industry.

exams.name: Certified Safety Director
exams.blurb: Certification for directors accountable for corporate safety strategy, budgeting, auditing and regulatory relationships.

exams.name: Certified Safety Management Practitioner
exams.body: Institute for Safety and Health Management (ISHM)
exams.blurb: ISHM credential for practitioners applying safety management systems at operational level without full manager responsibilities.

exams.name: Certified Safety Manager
exams.blurb: Certification covering OSHA compliance, hazard analysis and safety programme administration for workplace safety managers.

exams.name: Certified Safety Professional
exams.blurb: Flagship BCSP certification requiring a degree, four years of professional safety experience and a five and a half hour examination.

exams.name: Certified Utility Safety Professional
exams.body: Utility Safety and Ops Leadership Network (USOLN)
exams.blurb: Certification for safety professionals in electric utility work covering OSHA 1910.269, grounding, clearances and incident investigation.

exams.name: Construction Health and Safety Technician
exams.blurb: BCSP certification for construction site safety specialists with three years of qualifying jobsite safety experience.

exams.name: Graduate Safety Practitioner
exams.blurb: Designation awarded to graduates of BCSP-qualified academic programmes, waiving the ASP requirement on the path to the CSP.

exams.name: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Lead Auditor
exams.body: Exemplar Global and IRCA-Accredited Training Providers
exams.blurb: Five-day accredited course and examination qualifying auditors to lead occupational health and safety management system audits.

exams.name: NEBOSH International General Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety
exams.body: National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health (NEBOSH)
exams.blurb: Widely recognised entry qualification in occupational safety management, accepted by BCSP as a credential toward the CSP.

exams.name: Occupational Hygiene and Safety Technician
exams.blurb: BCSP technician certification for staff performing industrial hygiene sampling and occupational safety duties in the field.

exams.name: Safety Management Specialist
exams.blurb: BCSP certification for experienced managers whose duties include directing safety programmes, people and budgets.

exams.name: Safety Trained Supervisor
exams.blurb: Two-hour BCSP examination for supervisors and crew leaders whose primary job is not safety but who influence workplace conditions.

exams.name: Safety Trained Supervisor Construction
exams.blurb: Construction-focused BCSP supervisory certification covering jobsite hazard control, toolbox talks and crew safety leadership.

exams.name: Aerial Lift and MEWP Operator Certification
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926.453 and ANSI A92 Standards
exams.blurb: Operator qualification covering mobile elevating work platform inspection, fall protection and safe positioning under ANSI A92 standards.

exams.name: Bloodborne Pathogens Awareness Training
exams.blurb: Annual training on exposure control plans, universal precautions and post-exposure procedures required for at-risk employees.

exams.name: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations Function-Specific Training
exams.body: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA)
exams.blurb: Function-specific instruction on classification, packaging, marking, labelling, placarding and shipping papers under 49 CFR Parts 171-180.

exams.name: DOT Hazmat Employee Training
exams.body: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA)
exams.blurb: Recurrent training required every three years for anyone who prepares, handles or transports hazardous materials in commerce.

exams.name: Excavation and Trenching Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P
exams.blurb: Competent person training on soil classification, protective systems, access and daily inspection of excavations and trenches.

exams.name: Fall Protection Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart M
exams.blurb: Competent person training on fall hazard identification, anchorage selection, harness inspection and rescue planning at height.

exams.name: Hazard Communication and GHS Training
exams.blurb: Training on GHS labels, pictograms and safety data sheets required for every employee exposed to hazardous chemicals at work.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials First Responder Awareness Level Training
exams.blurb: Awareness-level training for personnel likely to discover a hazardous substance release and required to notify emergency responders.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials First Responder Operations Level Training
exams.blurb: Eight-hour operations-level training for responders taking defensive action to contain a hazardous substance release from a safe distance.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Technician Level Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(q) and NFPA 470
exams.blurb: Twenty-four hour minimum training for responders who take offensive action to plug, patch or stop a hazardous materials release.

exams.name: HAZWOPER 24-Hour Training
exams.blurb: Training for occasional site workers and visitors unlikely to be exposed above permissible limits on hazardous waste sites.

exams.name: HAZWOPER 40-Hour Training
aka: Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response
exams.blurb: Initial training required for general site workers on uncontrolled hazardous waste sites, plus three days of supervised field experience.

exams.name: HAZWOPER 8-Hour Annual Refresher
exams.blurb: Annual refresher required to keep HAZWOPER 24-hour or 40-hour site worker training current for hazardous waste operations.

exams.name: HAZWOPER 8-Hour Supervisor Training
exams.blurb: Supplemental training for on-site managers covering health and safety plans, monitoring programmes and spill containment oversight.

exams.name: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training
exams.body: ANSI/ASSP Z390.1 Accepted Practices for H2S Training Programs
exams.blurb: Training for oil, gas and wastewater workers on hydrogen sulfide properties, detection, respiratory protection and rescue procedures.

exams.name: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Training
exams.blurb: Category-based training required every 24 months for shippers and freight staff preparing dangerous goods for carriage by air.

exams.name: IMDG Code Dangerous Goods Training
exams.blurb: Training on classification, packing, segregation and documentation for shipping dangerous goods by sea under the IMDG Code.

exams.name: Lead Awareness Training
exams.blurb: Awareness training on lead exposure routes, permissible exposure limits, hygiene facilities and medical surveillance requirements.

exams.name: Lockout/Tagout Authorized Employee Training
exams.blurb: Training for authorised employees on energy-isolating devices, machine-specific procedures and periodic inspection of energy control.

exams.name: NFPA 70E Electrical Safety in the Workplace Training
exams.blurb: Qualified person training on arc flash boundaries, incident energy analysis, PPE categories and energised work permits.

exams.name: Permit-Required Confined Space Entry Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 and 1926 Subpart AA
exams.blurb: Training for entrants, attendants and entry supervisors covering atmospheric testing, permits, ventilation and rescue arrangements.

exams.name: Powered Industrial Truck (Forklift) Operator Certification
exams.blurb: Formal instruction, practical evaluation and three-yearly re-evaluation required before an employee may operate a powered industrial truck.

exams.name: Process Safety Management Training
exams.blurb: Training on the fourteen PSM elements including process hazard analysis, mechanical integrity and management of change.

exams.name: RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (40 CFR Part 262)
exams.blurb: Annual training for large-quantity generator personnel on waste determination, accumulation, manifesting and contingency planning.

exams.name: Respirable Crystalline Silica Competent Person Training
exams.blurb: Competent person training on Table 1 control methods, exposure assessment and written exposure control plans for silica dust.

exams.name: Respirator Fit Test Administrator Training
exams.blurb: Training for personnel administering qualitative and quantitative respirator fit tests and managing written respiratory protection programmes.

exams.name: Scaffold Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart L
exams.blurb: Competent person training on scaffold erection, capacity, fall protection and pre-shift inspection of supported and suspended scaffolds.
